auth.label: MCP Key

actions.name: design_create_image_upload_url
actions.description: Returns a temporary PUT upload URL. Upload the image binary to this URL using HTTP PUT, then pass the returned image URL to design_submit_workflow. This tool only creates the upload URL and does not accept image binaries or large base64 payloads.

content_type.description: Image MIME type, such as image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, image/gif, image/bmp or image/tiff. Convert HEIC/HEIF/SVG/PDF to JPEG or PNG first.

file_extension.description: Optional image file extension; inferred from content_type when omitted.

expire_seconds.description: Upload URL lifetime in seconds, from 60 to 3600.

result.description: Structured MCP content when available; otherwise the original MCP content envelope.

outputSchema.description: The normalized Patsnap MCP tool result.

actions.name: design_get_stage_result
actions.description: Get execution result of a specific stage — returns the full business data (result_data) of a stage, which may be large. To get final results, typically use stage='feature_comparison' or 'generate_report'

stage.description: Stage name (required). Valid values: convert_lineart / image_search / rerank / rrf_fusion / feature_comparison / generate_report

result.description: Structured MCP content when available; otherwise the original MCP content envelope.

outputSchema.description: The normalized Patsnap MCP tool result.

actions.name: design_get_task_status
actions.description: Query workflow task status — returns lightweight task overview and per-stage summaries (status/duration/retry count/error message) without large result_data, suitable for high-frequency polling

result.description: Structured MCP content when available; otherwise the original MCP content envelope.

outputSchema.description: The normalized Patsnap MCP tool result.

actions.name: design_submit_workflow
actions.description: Submit FTO workflow task — triggers the full pipeline (lineart conversion → search → rerank → RRF fusion → feature comparison → report generation) in one shot. Returns a task_id for polling via design_get_task_status and fetching results via design_get_stage_result

main_field.description: Text description or search keywords for the image (optional). Describe the product/form/usage in a sentence or keywords (e.g. 'wireless charger'). The system auto-parses it into search syntax. Not a LOC code

loc_items.description: LOC classification items (optional), each with id and desc

simple_legal_status.description: Simple legal status filter (optional), comma-separated (0=expired, 1=active, 2=pending). Defaults to '1,2' if not provided. Pass '0,1,2' to include expired patents

result.description: Structured MCP content when available; otherwise the original MCP content envelope.

outputSchema.description: The normalized Patsnap MCP tool result.
